note: The cap's detail from code (src/stops/mars/detail.ts; the hook cap.detail of src/bodies/planet.ts): rock by place under the plates of the place, wherever one texel of the finest plate drawn is wider than a pixel of the master. wired: whether set.ts gives the hook to the cap at all. on: the width of that texel in master pixels at which the detail is none and whole (exactly none at or under the first, so every frame above keeps its bytes). strata: the layers of a wall. bandsKm: the thickness of a layer for the two counts; swing: the share by which a layer is lighter or darker; ledgeM: how far a hard layer stands out, as a height for the light. wanderKm, wanderCellKm: the layers rise and fall with the place by so much over cells of this size. wall: the sine of the slope at which ground starts to be wall and at which it is wall. talus: the same for the scree at the feet. grain: the stones of scree and plain. cellKm: the coarsest cell; ratio: each finer count's cells are so many times smaller (three counts); swing and heightM as for the strata, at the coarsest count, each finer one a half of the one before; talusShare: how much stronger on scree than on level ground. Every count goes out where its cell is finer than a pixel of the buffer (fwidth of its own coordinate, none from finest[1] cells a pixel, whole under finest[0]).
